description: Create the documentation_tasks table migration with stages enum, RLS policies, and update the TypeScript types file to include the new table type definitions.
steps: Create a new migration file at supabase/migrations/20260514000001_documentation_tasks.sql with: 1) A new enum type public.doc_task_stage with values: assigned, docs_requested, docs_received, draft_shared, draft_approved, agreement_shared, countersigned, part_b_shared, completed. 2) A documentation_tasks table with columns: id (uuid PK, gen_random_uuid()), booking_id (uuid NOT NULL references public.bookings(id) ON DELETE CASCADE), assigned_to (uuid NOT NULL references auth.users(id)), assigned_by (uuid references auth.users(id)), stage (doc_task_stage NOT NULL DEFAULT 'assigned'), notes (text), created_at (timestamptz DEFAULT now()), updated_at (timestamptz DEFAULT now()). 3) Enable RLS. 4) Indexes on booking_id, assigned_to, stage. 5) RLS policies: SELECT - admin sees all OR assigned_to = auth.uid() OR has_role documentation; INSERT - admin OR sales OR bd (they assign after booking); UPDATE - admin OR assigned_to = auth.uid() (documentation person updates stage); DELETE - admin only. 6) updated_at trigger using existing set_updated_at function.

Update src/integrations/supabase/types.ts to add a documentation_tasks table type definition in the Tables section (after bookings, alphabetically or at end of Tables block). Row type should include: id: string, booking_id: string, assigned_to: string, assigned_by: string | null, stage: Database['public']['Enums']['doc_task_stage'], notes: string | null, created_at: string, updated_at: string. Insert type should have booking_id, assigned_to required; rest optional. Update type: all optional. Also add the doc_task_stage enum to the Enums section of the types file with all 9 values.
Verify that the enum type doc_task_stage is also added to the Database['public']['Enums'] section in types.ts.
acceptance_criteria: Migration file exists at supabase/migrations/20260514000001_documentation_tasks.sql with valid SQL syntax
The documentation_tasks table has booking_id, assigned_to, assigned_by, stage, notes, created_at, updated_at columns
RLS is enabled with appropriate policies: admin sees all, documentation role users see their assigned tasks, sales/bd can insert
src/integrations/supabase/types.ts contains documentation_tasks in the Tables interface with Row, Insert, Update types
src/integrations/supabase/types.ts contains doc_task_stage in the Enums interface
verification: Run bunx tsc --noEmit and confirm zero errors
Run bun run build and confirm successful build
